Messages.Author: guntherbl
Messages.Body:
Eldritch Glimmer card says: "Strike: 2R damage, and this vampire can burn
X blood to get +X damage. Not usable first round. Usable at long range."
(At superior it's 4R damage, but the remaining text is the same).
Shouldn't it say "Usable ONLY at long range", as it is already clear that
it can be used at long by the "R" after the quantity of damage done?
How is this strike used, then? Only at long or both at long and close
range?
Thank you.

done?
> > How is this strike used, then? Only at long or both at long and close
> > range?

> Any ranged strike may be used at close range unless card text says other
> wise.

You missed the point, Norm. The card text says "Usable at long range"
but it also says "2R". Because the damage is ranged (2R), the phrase
"Usable at long range" is redundant and is a little confusing for him. The
main question remains - should the card have instead said "ONLY usable
at long range"?

Sorrow

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
guntherbl wrote:
>
> Eldritch Glimmer card says: "Strike: 2R damage, and this vampire can burn
> X blood to get +X damage. Not usable first round. Usable at long range."
> (At superior it's 4R damage, but the remaining text is the same).
> Shouldn't it say "Usable ONLY at long range", as it is already clear that
> it can be used at long by the "R" after the quantity of damage done?

No. The "usable at long range" was probably put in to help fend off
questions about the +X being ranged or not, even though, as you note, it
is redundant with the 'R' nature of the base damage.

> How is this strike used, then? Only at long or both at long and close
> range?

At either long or close range.

Messages.Author: Gomi no Sensei
Messages.Body:
In article <8t22q5$fjt$1...@nnrp1.deja.com>,

cantila <rogc...@student.luth.se> wrote:
>If I use EG with Ankara Citadel on my vamp. is the cost reduced for the
>extra blood burnt to do the extra dmg too?

No. Burning blood for additional damage is an effect of Eldritch Glimmer's
resolution, not a cost (contrast Hidden Strength, where the X blood burnt
is a cost, and therefore affected by Ankara Citadel).

Messages.Author: Derek Ray
Messages.Body:
On Mon, 23 Oct 2000 19:16:29 GMT, cantila <rogc...@student.luth.se>
wrote:

>If I use EG with Ankara Citadel on my vamp. is the cost reduced for the
>extra blood burnt to do the extra dmg too?

card text:

Eldritch Glimmer, Thaumaturgy, Combat, 1 blood

Strike: 2R damage, and this vampire can burn X blood to get +X damage.

Not usable first round. Usable at long range. (S) Strike: 4R damage,

and this vampire can burn X blood to get +X damage. Not usable first
round. Usable at long range.

So no, the blood spent is not reduced, as Ankara Citadel only reduces
the -cost- of the card, which is 1 blood. The additional +X damage is
a "burn blood" function of the card itself, not the cost.
